title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-005
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence from the public requesting information from the FAA regarding a widely reported 1986 Japan Air Lines UFO sighting; it contains no firsthand encounter reports, only references to the JAL incident.

encounters.summary: Japan Air Lines flight crew reported a UFO sighting in Alaska airspace on November 17, 1986.
